rows.summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries has expanded its product portfolio by entering the tequila and ready-to-drink beverage markets. The move aims to capture growing consumer demand in emerging alcoholic beverage categories. This diversification could alter the company's revenue mix and growth trajectory. Indian retail investors should monitor how these new launches impact future quarterly margins and market share.
rows.why_it_matters: New product segments could boost long-term revenue growth.
rows.winners_losers: Associated Alcohols gains / competing brands challenged
